summary.text: Mark Sauter represents Idaho House District 1, Seat A, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Sauter retired after 30 years in the fire service, rising from firefighter to fire chief.
It lists a B.A. in fire administration from California State University, Los Angeles, and a master's degree in public administration from the University of Southern California.
The biography also lists Sauter as an Idaho Family Forest owner since 1993.

sources.title: Idaho House of Representatives membership directory (2026 session)
